text:
Liam (AE): Piccadilly procurement put signing on hold. They want a clean MSA/DPA + order form, split invoicing to UK ops, and they only accept signatures via NotarizePro (their internal tool). tagging @Harper @Noah :wave

Rina (SE): Do they need Hosted or Dedicated for the POC? That affects SCC applicability and KMS language.

Liam (AE): Dedicated in eu-west-2 for PHI test traffic. They asked for BYOK + HSM attestations and 99.95% SLA with 1 hour response.

Harper (Legal): 1 hour response is tough. We can offer 1 hour notification + 4 hour mitigation for Dedicated. I'll prepare a DPA with SCC annex and a KMS appendix.

Noah (Finance): For split invoicing we'll need the UK VAT ID and billing address. They want GBP invoiced to UK entity and USD to their US research arm. We can do separate line items. Net45 request from them 3 is that negotiable?

Liam (AE): They asked net45 for UK leg. Deal is 48k/year committed. Procurement says they'll raise two POs after docs are clean.

Rina (SE): Technical note: our HSM gateway supports PKCS#11 and AWS/GCP KMS. For BYOK imports we document rotation responsibility as "customer" and we keep key usage metadata. I'll attach the BYOK checklist doc.

esign-gateway-bot: Third-party e-sign policy: NotarizePro requires legal review of sample audit logs and signer authority. See: https://internal.redwood/esign-policy

Harper (Legal): I'll request their NotarizePro audit sample. If audit log acceptable, we can accept NotarizePro-signed PDFs provided we retain signer metadata. Also adding countersign delegation: Director-level countersign up to $100k; CFO above that.

Noah (Finance): AR can accept net45 for UK on a case-by-case. Need procurement confirmation and the PO numbers. Billing must be cc'd on the signed order (billing@redwood).

Liam (AE): Action items:
- Harper: clean MSA + DPA + KMS appendix + modified SLA language by EOD BST
- Rina: BYOK checklist + deployment checklist for eu-west-2
- Noah: prepare dual-invoice order form template and confirm net45 exception path
- Liam: ask Piccadilly for NotarizePro sample audit log and VAT/PO details

Rina (SE): Also their infra asked for a model-pinning clause for first 90 days. I'll note compatibility caveats.

Harper (Legal): I'll add model-pinning: "Customer may pin a Major.Minor model for up to 90 days; Redwood may unpin for security or performance reasons with 30 days notice." I'll upload clean bundle to thread when ready.

Liam (AE): Thanks team 3 I'll chase procurement for the audit log and VAT now and update thread. :white_check_mark:
